data.modules_power: Total Watt peak power of your solar modules

learning.title: Plant entry: totals and self-learning
learning.description: Optional, enable in ONE entry only: this entry then provides total sensors for all entries and learns from the actual PV yield (efficiency per season, time-of-day profile, correction of the rest of today, accuracy statistics).

data_description.learn_actual_entity: Energy sensor of today's total PV yield that resets every day (e.g. daily PV energy of the inverter).
data_description.learn_cloud_entity: Sensor with the average cloud cover of the day in %. Empty: the cloud cover of Open-Meteo between sunrise and sunset is used.
data_description.learn_cloud_threshold: Up to this cloud cover a day counts fully; cloudier days count less.
data_description.learn_smoothing: Weight of a new clear day (0.2 = 20 % new, 80 % previous).
data_description.learn_min_days: Weighted days (a clear day counts 1) before the learned factor is considered reliable.
data_description.learn_auto_apply: Once learned, the seasonal factor and the time-of-day profile correct the forecast of all entries.
data_description.learn_intraday: Compares the actual yield so far with the forecast and corrects the rest of today.
data_description.learn_compare_model: Open-Meteo model forecast once a day for comparison (e.g. best_match). Empty = off.
data_description.learn_sunset_offset: Minutes after sunset when the day is evaluated.

error.learn_actual_required: Please select the sensor with the actual daily PV yield.
error.learn_cloud_required: Please select a cloud cover sensor.

learning_evaluate.description: Compare today's actual yield with the forecast right now (normally done automatically after sunset). Only use it after the sun has set.

history.description: List of daily values with d (date), v (actual/forecast) and k (clear true/false).
